The image makes this very clear. Looking directly at the California Driver License card on p.10, the DL number is printed as **O7314062** — with a clearly styled letter **O** (not a zero), consistent with California's DL numbering format which begins with a letter. The OCR system misread it as `07314062` (digit zero).

All three sources — the driver schedule (f005:s1), the MVR report text layer (f009:p9), and the actual license image (f009:p10) — all show the same license number: **O7314062** (letter O followed by 7314062).
